about_the_game:
Explore a charming world that slowly reveals its darker side as you move forward.
Face enemies, defeat challenging bosses, copy their abilities,
and follow a path that grows ever deeper into the shadows.

A Metroidvania-lite with Soulslike-inspired combat,
where striking at the right moment is the key to victory —
the more anxious you are, the harder the journey becomes.

Each boss you defeat grants you a new power.
Grow stronger and stronger until you uncover the
truth behind this world and defeat the darkness.

Loreninha falls asleep and awakens in a world of vibrant dreams,
now being consumed by an ever-growing darkness.
But perhaps it’s not just a dream...

  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / AMD Radeon Vega 8
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 20.04
  • Processor: Quad Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
